title: Knowledge base
context: Reference books the triage assistant may quote. A book is not used until a clinical reviewer approves it.
empty: No books yet. Upload a PDF to begin.
error: We could not load the books.
changeError: That change could not be saved.
notAllowed: Only a platform admin can manage the knowledge base.
rightsHelp: Who allows this book to be used, for example "Owner-supplied copy, licence confirmed".
approveHelp: Once approved, the triage assistant can quote this book. Only approve a book a clinician has reviewed.
rightsConfirm: I confirm we have the right to use this book.
retireBody: The triage assistant will stop quoting it immediately.
deleteBody: The file and all its passages are removed. This cannot be undone.
testHelp: Search a book before approving it.
